admission.justification: Atomic own-copy publication, readable-sibling exclusion, foreign membership and conditional unknown-file handling jointly keep unrelated enclosure evidence from controlling publication while preserving the own failure path; no single member guarantees that combined boundary.

guarantee: Own task-copy publication remains atomic without admitting a foreign contract as an enclosure or letting a readable sibling determine its outcome; an indeterminate unreadable contract is tolerated only past staged own copies, otherwise refresh fails closed.
title: Own-copy publication without foreign enclosure ownership
